summary: Full backend + frontend testing for NOI DI 2D. 27/27 pytest cases pass across auth, admin, events, chat, P2P actions, push VAPID, and Study AI (Gemini). Frontend flows verified via Playwright: admin login → dashboard, admin panel, event create/list/delete + signup + urgency, chat with automatic censorship of Italian bad words, study page rendering with subject input and quiz start. Fixed 1 real backend bug (ObjectId leaked in create_event response causing 500).

minor.issue: Fix applied: Motor's insert_one was mutating the event dict with '_id' (ObjectId) which then failed JSON serialization → 500. Fixed by inserting a shallow copy dict(event) and popping '_id' before returning.

issues: Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' — a11y warning, not blocking

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to Radix DialogContent in Events.js and any other modal for accessibility (removes console warning).

OPTIONAL: Also guard against '_id' leakage in other endpoints that return the same dict passed to insert_one, e.g. chat/messages already uses dict(msg) copy — safe. Actions and users use dict() as well — verified safe.
critical_code_review_comments: Bug (FIXED): Events.create_event returned the same dict passed to Motor's insert_one, which mutates the arg adding an ObjectId '_id' → JSON serialization crash. Pattern: always insert a copy or pop _id before returning.
server.py is a single ~510-line file — acceptable for MVP but consider splitting into routers (auth/, admin/, events/, chat/, actions/, study/, push/) if the project grows.
censor() uses regex per bad word per message; fine for now but could be precompiled once at module load for perf.
P2P antispam window (4s) is enforced only on send; the client-side signup toggle for events depends on same user id — works.
study/upload accepts any non-pdf as utf-8 text with errors='ignore' — fine, but no MIME/size check; large binaries would still be accepted and stored (truncated to 12k chars).
Emergent LLM key + Gemini 3.1 Pro works for both study/chat and study/flashcards (verified live).
test_credentials: Admin: admin@noidi2d.it / AdminNoi2D! (auto-seeded). Fresh test members are registered per test-run with random emails and approved by admin.
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral users (test_member_*@noidi2d.it) and events (TEST_* prefix). Leftover TEST_ events were cleaned up at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full test suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and covers auth (register/pending/login), admin CRUD, events lifecycle, chat + censor, P2P actions (send/inbox/antispam 429), push VAPID, and Gemini study (flashcards + interrogazione). All 27 pass. The only fix applied by testing agent was in server.py create_event (ObjectId leak). Frontend Playwright covered admin flow end-to-end including event create + signup + chat censor + study page load. Study AI end-to-end via UI wasn't asserted for actual AI reply but backend tests confirm Gemini works. Push subscribe requires a real browser subscription; only vapid-public was validated.
rca of the issue: 500 on POST /api/events → Motor's insert_one mutates the passed dict in-place adding MongoDB '_id' (ObjectId). The endpoint then returned that same dict via '{**event, ...}', and FastAPI/Starlette's JSON encoder cannot serialize ObjectId → ValueError 'ObjectId is not iterable / vars() argument must have __dict__' → 500. Reproduction: POST /api/events with any valid payload as admin. Mitigation: insert a copy (dict(event)) and pop '_id' before return. This unblocked event create/list/signup/delete which had cascading failures.
